verdict: A slow lead week masked by a sharper drop in local search visibility.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 8 leads at $225.31 cost per lead across $1,802.44 in total ad spend — and the last three days of the period produced zero leads on nearly $100 in spend, confirming a short-term drought that needs to be closed quickly. More pressing is the organic side: Google Business Profile actions fell 55% week-over-week and dropped to zero on September 26–27, meaning local search is not delivering the floor-level visibility it was earlier this month. Search clicks also fell sharply, hitting zero on three of the last six days. Five overdue deliverables — including the booking automation, the Homer Glen branch page, and the LSA heating re-enable — are being resolved on a defined timeline, with heating campaigns on Google and Meta scheduled to go live October 1. Clearing those items and launching into the fall heating season is the primary lever for improving both lead volume and local visibility in the next period.

watch_item.fix: Local profile and search activity is being reviewed this week; fall heating content is scheduled to be indexed by September 30, which should restore and grow organic visibility heading into peak season.
